title: 粉黑动作字场变体｜成年奔跑者以行动生成空间短词
source_title: 图形跑酷字场｜奔跑、撞击与挥击依次生成语义词
summary: 把来源的青少年与刺客表面完全排除，改用原创明确成年人；角色在固定粉黑城市轴线上奔跑、落地、挥击和停步，每次动作开始后只生成一个语义短词，并让文字成为可落脚、可击中或可穿越的空间结构。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, three identity anchors and one continuous world axis. + Bind each decisive action to exactly one short original semantic word that appears only after the action begins. + Make each word occupy, divide, reflect or redirect the physical environment rather than float as a subtitle. + Escalate typography scale and spatial depth while preserving identity, travel direction and readable action. + Return to the same adult face or full-body anchor and resolve the word sequence into one terminal identity proof.
recommended_input: 奶油与钴蓝图形城市上方建立原创明确成年跑酷制图师：铜色马尾、白色护目镜、炭灰连体服和青色肘带；她第一次踏上屋顶后才生成空间准确短词【ROUTE】。；落地击裂一块已注册网格地砖，并从冲击点升起实体准确短词【GROUND】；全部身份锚点保持稳定。；终局让成年人直立在坡道后，准确金属主标【MAP THE MOVE】同框；原始城市与前面两个路线锚点继续可见。
required_anchors: One clearly adult original performer and a stable world axis are established before any semantic word appears.
Each decisive action begins before exactly one related short word becomes visible.
Identity and geography remain continuous across run, landing, strike and terminal stance.
The final mark follows the completed route and retains at least two previously established spatial anchors.
